text: あら…　わたしの　いえを　ねんじて　いたら　なぜか　こんな　ところに…？

structure.jp: わたしの　いえを　ねんじて　いたら
structure.en: when I was picturing my house in my mind

structure.jp: なぜか　こんな　ところに…？
structure.en: somehow, in a place like this...?

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら here means 'when I did this, I found that', leading to a surprise. ねんじて　いたら = 'when I was picturing it...'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: A て verb plus いる shows something going on over time. ねんじて　いた = 'was picturing in my mind'.
